name: Circle Flags
about: Circle Flags is a free, open-source icon set with 745 icons designed by HatScripts. Search any country or territory name to find its flag in seconds. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Circle Flags free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 745 Circle Flags are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which flags are included in Circle Flags?
faqs.a: The set holds 745 flag icons. Search any country or territory name above to find its flag instantly.

faqs.q: Are the flags in Circle Flags up to date?
faqs.a: Flag designs follow the official national flags as of the set's latest release. If a flag recently changed, check the set's source repository for the newest version.

faqs.q: How do I use Circle Flags in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: What formats are Circle Flags available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
